title: [3.0.0.1] After entering carbohydrates in the bolus calculator, no carbohydrates are displayed.
symptom: After entering carbohydrates in the bolus calculator and confirming with OK, no carbohydrates are displayed on the main screen. This happens sometimes, not always.
evidence_quote: I have noticed several times now that when using the bolus calculator, after entering the carbohydrates and confirming with OK, no carbohydrates are displayed on the main screen.
